policy: Acceptance is evidence-based: a criterion is PASS only with concrete evidence; media criteria (media=true) require evidence files produced by direct inspection (frames, measurements) or the result must be NOT_VERIFIED, which forces human review. No numeric scores.

historical_research.text: Every claim is labelled ESTABLISHED/DISPUTED/UNKNOWN/DRAMATIZATION and has an ID
Each cited source exists, is named precisely, was actually consulted, and has a reliability note; no invented URLs/pages/quotes
Core sequence of events and commanders is supported by at least two independent sources, or flagged DISPUTED
Uncertainty (numbers, manoeuvres, dates) is documented with ranges and who claims what
Depiction constraints and open cultural/religious questions are recorded; nothing contradicts PROJECT.md hard constraints

story_treatment.text: Dramatic coherence: clear protagonist question, escalation, turning point and resolution within the runtime
Every beat carries a fidelity tag that matches the approved HISTORICAL_BIBLE; no disputed point is resolved by invention
Runtime allocation sums to the target within 5%
Protagonist centrality while preceding commanders are represented accurately
AI-production feasibility notes are realistic (faces, crowds, action)

screenplay.text: Historical consistency with the approved bible; all invented dialogue is tagged DRAMATIZATION; no fabricated quotes presented as authentic
Dramatic coherence and pacing: each scene has want/obstacle/outcome; runtime within 5% of target
English dialogue quality: period-plausible voice, no modern idiom, speakable, economical, subtext over exposition
Character continuity: names, titles, knowledge, emotional arc consistent across scenes
Production feasibility for AI generation; scene IDs stable and unique
Matches the approved treatment beat for beat, or deviations are listed and justified

visual_bible.text: Identity locks are specific enough to reproduce a face/body/wardrobe consistently; identity prompts exist for each principal
Period plausibility of costume, armour, weapons, architecture, terrain is graded DOCUMENTED/PLAUSIBLE/INVENTED against the historical bible
Geography map and time/weather per scene are unambiguous and consistent with the screenplay
Style guide defines photorealistic look, palette, lighting, prompt grammar and negative prompt
Reference images (if any exist) match the written identity locks
Depiction policy (Q-003) is resolved and respected; no prohibited depiction

shot_list.text: Every shot references valid scene/character/environment/prop IDs from approved bibles
Temporal and spatial continuity: screen direction, time of day, weather, costume/damage state are consistent across consecutive shots
Cinematic composition and coverage: each scene has establishing/medium/close variety suited to its dramatic intent
Durations are feasible for AI video and total within 5% of runtime
Prompts follow the style-guide grammar, reuse identity/environment prompts verbatim and contain no anachronism

proof_of_concept.text: Visual realism: photoreal at full resolution, no obvious AI artefacts
Motion quality: no morphing, jitter, floating, physics breaks across the clip
Anatomical correctness: hands, faces, limbs, horses, weapon grip
Character consistency with the approved identity lock
Cinematic composition and lighting match the style guide
Technical properties (resolution, fps, codec, duration) measured with probe and recorded
Report states tool, model, attempts, failures and actual costs truthfully

production_plan.text: Plan covers every remaining stage with owner, dependencies, tools and fallbacks
Cost plan separates estimate from actual, uses real provider pricing, and includes failure/revision allowance
Per-batch authorization points are defined; no spend is assumed approved
Risks and BLOCKED_EXTERNAL_TOOL items are listed honestly

rough_cut.text: Temporal and spatial continuity across cuts (screen direction, light, wardrobe, geography)
Pacing and runtime within 5% of target; scene order matches screenplay
Audio synchronization: dialogue/SFX aligned with picture (measured offset and listening notes)
Dialogue delivery quality in English: intelligibility, performance, no artefacts
Every shot used is APPROVED with a matching accepted shot review
Historical continuity and no prohibited depiction in any frame

final_delivery.text: Technical delivery specification met (resolution, fps, codec, container, loudness, duration) — measured
Visual and audio integrity across the full runtime (no dropped frames, glitches, clipping)
Subtitles/credits/DRAMATIZATION notices present as required by the brief
Checksums, manifest, source register and cost reconciliation delivered
No unresolved BLOCKER findings from any review cycle

shot_media.text: Visual realism: photoreal, no plastic skin, no melted detail
Cinematic composition: framing, depth, lens feel, lighting direction match the shot list and style guide
Motion quality: smooth, physically plausible, no morphing or jitter (video only)
Anatomical correctness: hands, faces, limbs, mounts, weapons
Character consistency vs identity lock and reference images
Temporal and spatial continuity with neighbouring shots (time, weather, direction, wardrobe state)
Period plausibility: no anachronistic objects, text or logos
No prohibited depiction (Prophet Muhammad) and depiction policy respected

dialogue_audio.text: English dialogue text matches the approved screenplay verbatim
Voice performance matches delivery notes; intelligible; no synthetic artefacts

audio_bed.text: Levels measured by direct inspection: no clipping (max <= -1 dBFS), bed sits under dialogue; evidence file required
Rights documented: generated, licensed or public-domain; no copyrighted music or recognisable melodies
Mood, period plausibility and continuity fit the approved sound plan (no anachronistic instruments or sounds)
